## What it is

<!-- KEEP:what-it-is:START -->
The multi-tenancy of the core (ADR-TENANT-001 … 009): the tenant registry `CORE_TENANT` (global), the request
tenant (`TenantContext`, resolved from the token's `tid` claim or `X-Tenant-Code`, or the default tenant in
`single` mode), tenant provisioning (`POST /api/v1/platform/tenants`) with the `TenantProvisioningContributor` SPI,
the tenant data export with the `TenantExportContributor` SPI, branding (logo, colour) and the anonymous
`GET /api/v1/public/app-config`. `TenantPolicy` answers what differs per deployment; `TenantRunner` walks the tenants
for jobs. The mode property is read here and in `autoconfigure` only.
<!-- KEEP:what-it-is:END -->

## When to use it

<!-- KEEP:when-to-use:START -->
Whenever code runs outside a request (job, listener, startup runner): `TenantContext.runAs` / `callAs`, or
`TenantRunner.forEachTenant` to cover every tenant. When the application seeds reference data every tenant
needs: a `TenantProvisioningContributor`. When the application has its own tenant tables: a
`TenantExportContributor`, so the platform export is complete. When a tenant's code or name is shown:
`TenantLookupApi`. Never to decide "am I single-tenant?" — that question does not exist for a module.
<!-- KEEP:when-to-use:END -->

## How to call it

<!-- KEEP:how-to-call:START -->
```java
// a job over every active tenant (single: the default tenant), each inside TenantContext.runAs
tenantRunner.forEachTenant(tenantId -> reminderService.sendDue());

// reference data for a new tenant, copied with explicit TENANT_ID from the source tenant
@Component class ShopProvisioning implements TenantProvisioningContributor {
    public void provision(TenantProvisioning p) {
        jdbc.update("INSERT INTO SHOP_PRICE_LIST (ID, TENANT_ID, CODE, NAME) SELECT nextval('SEQ_SHOP_PRICE_LIST'), ?, CODE, NAME"
            + " FROM SHOP_PRICE_LIST WHERE TENANT_ID = ?", p.tenantId(), p.sourceTenantId());
    }
}

// the tenant's display name next to a document
Optional<TenantSummary> tenant = tenantLookupApi.summaryOf(TenantContext.require());
```
<!-- KEEP:how-to-call:END -->
